help.root._description: Scan, triage, and archive AI work documents across projects
help.type.non_negative_int: Specify an integer of 0 or more
help.scope.paths: Roots to scan once (no config needed)
help.scope.profile: Use a named profile from the config
help.scope.project_dir: Directory to read the project .docsweep.yaml from
help.scope.work_dir: Work queue path relative to the project (default docs/local)
help.scope.allow_sensitive: Explicitly allow saving and showing text that looks like a secret
help.common.prune_projects: CASCADE-delete projects left with no documents within the current search_paths (default off)
help.common.project_root_abs: Absolute path of the project root
help.common.ai_model_id: Exact model ID reported by the runtime
help.common.ai_model_display: Model display name seen in the UI, etc.
help.common.actor_key: Stable key of the person who operated the AI
help.scan.all: Show all documents (default: needs-decision and pending only)
help.scan.project: Limit to a project (same as sweep/promote)
help.triage._command: List files that need a decision, with allowed_actions
help.triage.tag: List only md files with this frontmatter tag (repeat for OR)
help.triage.show: Add columns (owner / tags); also switches to a human-readable table
help.triage.head: Show only the first N items (for one-at-a-time loops; UX W2 / P33)
help.apply._command: Apply an action to a single file
help.apply.path: Absolute path of the target file
help.apply.watching_days: Only with relabel --to watching: set this graduation due date to today + N days
help.sweep._command: Same as --auto: move done/discarded documents to archive
help.sweep.project: Limit to a project (same as promote)
help.sweep.dry_run: Only print what would be moved
help.mv._command: Move documents within the work queue and rewrite references from other documents
help.mv._description: Move documents within the work queue. References to the moved documents (docsweep_parent, path-style related entries, and exact repo-relative paths in the body) are rewritten to the new path. Files tracked by git and files inside archive are excluded. Use docsweep undo to revert.
help.mv.sources: Documents to move (files in the work queue)
help.mv.to: Destination directory (inside the work queue; created if missing)
help.mv.dry_run: Only show the planned moves and rewrites
help.mv.no_body: Do not rewrite paths in the body (rewrite frontmatter references only)
help.serve._command: Start the local Web UI (127.0.0.1, token-protected)
help.serve.no_browser: Do not open a browser automatically
help.serve.token: Fixed access token (default: DOCSWEEP_TOKEN, otherwise a new random token each time)
help.serve.read_only: Browse and search only (write APIs return 403) (UX W4 / P58)
help.serve.allow_root_mutation: Allow adding scan roots from the Web UI (default: denied)
help.promote._command: Release sweep: promote watching documents to done and archive them
help.promote.due_expired: Only watching documents whose due date has arrived (including today)
help.promote.yes: Accept the two-step confirmation for large batches (UX W4 / P59)
help.index_sync._command: Sync changes into the SQLite index (mtime changes only); scans under projects.search_paths
help.index_rebuild._command: Rebuild the whole SQLite index (clear the files table, rescan everything, then VACUUM)
help.index_rebuild.no_vacuum: Skip the final VACUUM (default: run VACUUM)
help.index_watch._command: Watch search_paths and sync the index when md files change (requires watchdog)
help.index_stats._command: Show the index DB size, row counts, embedding size, and freelist (start here for bloat)
help.index_vacuum._command: Run VACUUM manually to release the index DB freelist and shrink the file
help.brief._command: Pick today's one item (morning entry point); --all summarizes all projects side by side
help.brief.all: Summarize all projects side by side (all search_paths)
help.brief.continue: Skip the final prompt and copy the context of today's item to the clipboard
help.cross._command: Pick today's one item across all projects and list documents about to go stale
help.cross.explain: Show the score breakdown for a file
help.capture._command: Extract plan/bugfix/pending drafts from a conversation log (heuristic / LLM)
help.capture.save_all: Save all extracted candidates to the configured work_dir
help.linkcheck._command: Check a plan's planned file changes against the actual implementation
help.linkcheck.file: Check a single plan (default: all plan_*.md)
help.auto_triage._command: Suggest (--suggest) or apply (--apply) state changes using an LLM or heuristics
help.auto_triage.suggest: Print suggestions as JSON (does not apply them)
help.auto_triage.apply: Read decisions from a JSON file and apply them in bulk
help.auto_triage.dry_run: With --apply, show the plan without applying it
help.graph._command: Output the plan/bugfix/pending relationship network as JSON
help.resurrect._command: Find similar pairs between archived and current plans (embedding / Jaccard)
help.resurrect.no_embedding: Skip embeddings and use only the Jaccard fallback
help.resurrect.top_k: Number of active candidates per archived document (default 1)
help.summary._command: Export a summary for AI (compressed INDEX as JSON)
help.new.title: H1 title (default: the topic)
help.new.allow_sensitive: Explicitly allow saving text that looks like a secret
help.new.project_dir: Project to create in (default: found by walking up from cwd to a project marker such as .git)
help.new.due: Initial due date as YYYY-MM-DD (default: computed from due.default_offset_days[plan/pending] in .docsweep.yaml; a new bugfix gets none)
help.new.no_due: Do not add an initial due date (ignore the .docsweep.yaml offset and write no due to the frontmatter)
help.new.target_release: Optional safe label for the planned release (e.g. v0.9.x / v0.9.1 / 2026-Q3)
help.new.split: Create a parent plan and N child plans with two-way related links and docsweep_parent (UX W3 / P26)
help.new.titles: Short names for each --split child (comma-separated, same count as --split); file names become plan_<parent-topic>_c<N>_<short>.md so each child's scope shows in its name
help.new.delegate: Create a plan whose implementation is delegated to another AI (adds docsweep_delegation: external and a C details section template)
help.new.ai_session_log: Full path to the raw session log of the vendor CLI (default: resolved from environment variables; automatic for Claude Code only)
help.provenance._command: Record and check the authoring AI and the per-C implementation, review, and verification AIs
help.provenance.project_dir: Target project root (default: detected from cwd)
help.provenance.model_source: Where the model information came from (orchestrator/runtime/cli/ui/user-reported/unavailable)
help.provenance.finish.execution: AIX execution ID returned by start
help.provenance.init._command: Register the authoring AI provenance for an existing MD
help.provenance.init.update: Update the existing work's authoring row and frontmatter AI metadata to actual values (execution_id / work_id / started_at stay unchanged)
help.provenance.start._command: Start an AI execution for a C unit
help.provenance.start.context: C1 or C1,C2; not-applicable for the whole document
help.provenance.finish.evidence_ref: Add one evidence ID (repeatable; recommended in PowerShell)
help.provenance.finish.notes: Short note that replaces the existing notes
help.provenance.check._command: Check consistency between the MD, the ledger, and C references
help.provenance.check.fix_work_path: Set the ledger work_path to the current path for rows whose work_id and ai_execution_refs match but whose work_path differs (rows whose recorded location still holds another file are left alone)
help.review._command: Pick documents from an interactive checklist and move them to archive
help.inject.no_guidance: Inject only the label section, without the guidance and due rules (when they live in the global settings)
help.inject.global: Inject the guidance and due rules into your personal global settings (applies to all projects)
help.inject.lang: Language of the injected text (default: the project's document language; the display language with --global)
help.inject.global_target: Override the global injection target with an explicit path
help.eject._command: Remove injected managed blocks (hand-written text is kept)
help.eject.all: Remove from every project and global target recorded in the manifest
help.eject.global: Remove the guidance from the global settings
help.eject.agent: AI tool of the global target (with --global)
help.eject.global_target: Override the global target with an explicit path
help.migrate_frontmatter._command: Add OKF frontmatter to existing md files non-destructively (H1 labels are kept)
help.fix_related._command: Make one-way related: [B] links symmetric by adding them to B as well
help.show._command: Show the plan/bugfix/pending documents that reference a file
help.show.file: Absolute path of the target md, or a path within the scan roots
help.stale._command: List early staleness candidates by review_status (separate thresholds for draft/review/published)
help.context._command: Print the body, parent plan, and related documents to stdout as one AI prompt
help.claim._command: Set the frontmatter owner to the current user
help.config._command: Read and write docsweep's own user settings (~/.docsweep/config.yaml)
help.config.value: Value to set (omit to get the current value)
help.config.from_github: Set the value from the gh CLI login account (gh api user --jq .login) (user.name only)
help.activity._command: Group recently touched (mtime) and upcoming (due) documents by date; default: today + yesterday
help.activity.date: Add a target date (repeat for OR; default today+yesterday)
help.timeline._command: List plan/bugfix/pending documents containing a topic in time order
help.timeline.topic: Topic string in the file name or title
help.find.owner: Match owner ('me' for the current user)
help.find.status: State key or label (e.g. In Progress / done)
help.find.q: Full-text search (substring match in title/summary/body; MVP)
help.target_release._command: Show or set a document's target_release label
help.target_release.set._command: Set target_release on an existing MD (config files are not changed)
help.release._command: Close a Git tag and archive by version
help.release.close._command: Check the MDs targeted at an existing Git tag and move them to archive
help.release.close.tag: Exact name of an existing Git tag (e.g. v0.9.1)
help.release.close.project_dir: Directory to read the target project's settings from
help.workspace._command: Inventory release tracking across repositories and migrate it via a manifest
Inventory multiple roots and propose the required settings and target migration
Path to the config to read workspace.roots from
Default target_release to fill in for MDs without one
Output JSON path for the inventory manifest
Explicitly apply the given manifest (per repo, atomic)
Apply the manifest generated in this run (default: dry-run)
On a TTY, confirm the initial settings and apply; otherwise show what needs confirmation
Automated mode (no prompts; dry-run unless --apply is given)
Where to write the migration journal (default ~/.docsweep/release-migrations)
help.completion._command: Print a shell completion script to stdout (bash/zsh/pwsh)
help.export._command: Export an OKF-compatible zip (shows that your md files stay usable without docsweep)
help.export.okf: Export in OKF format (currently the only format)
help.export.okf_version: Version of the bundled OKF profile to use (default: 0.2)
help.export.okf_profile: Local JSON or explicit URL of an OKF profile (not fetched by default)
help.export.okf_profile_sha256: Pinned SHA-256 of an external OKF profile
help.okf_check._command: Check any OKF Bundle read-only (unknown types / links are not rejected)
help.closeout_check._command: Check the closeout conditions of a parent plan and its child plans (read-only)
help.closeout_check.path: Parent plan to check (absolute path, or repo-relative path from cwd)
help.closeout_check.to: State you intend to move to (default: watching)
help.doctor._command: Check the environment (config / roots / index / inject / extras)
help.doctor.project_dir: Project boundary for the privacy check
help.init.lang: Language to write to the config (default: the display language)
help.undo._command: Undo the last archive / promote / mv batch (rewritten references and labels changed right before the move are restored too)
help.day._command: Open or close the day (open = morning / close = evening)
help.intent._command: Map a natural-language intent to a docsweep command
help.intent.text: Intent text (e.g. what did I do yesterday)
help.fix_conflict._command: Fix mismatches between the frontmatter and the H1 label
help.fix_conflict.prefer: Which side wins (both = same as h1)
help.notify._command: Show the overdue count as a local OS notification (no cloud push)
help.notify.dry_run: Show the message without sending it
help.project._command: Show the project exclusion list / turn projects on or off
help.project.list._command: List projects and whether each is enabled or excluded
help.project.enable._command: Remove a project from the exclusion list (turn it on)
help.project.disable._command: Add a project to the exclusion list (turn it off)
help.review_week._command: Summary for the weekly review (watching / old planned / suggestion counts)
help.cookbook.scenario: morning / release / onboard / ai / hygiene (omit to list them)
help.memory._command: Read-only scan of AI memory files (kept off the board)
help.demo._command: Create a throwaway sample project (for articles and first runs; existing files are not touched)
help.demo.dir: Where to create it (default: a new temporary directory)
help.ics._command: Export open documents with due dates as .ics
